questions.q: The Director of our company / does not believe that / we are working sincerely / for all these years.
questions.s: Tense Error! Jab 'for/since + time' diya ho (for all these years), toh Present Perfect Continuous use hota hai. 'We have been working' sahi hoga.

questions.q: We have received / many informations / regarding the / activities of the terrorists.
questions.s: Noun Error! 'Information' uncountable noun hai. Iska plural nahi banta. Sahi phrase: 'Many pieces of information' ya 'Much information'.

questions.q: There is no possibility / of you coming home / late / so you must leave now.
questions.s: Gerund Rule! 'Coming' ek Gerund hai. Usse pehle Noun/Pronoun possessive case mein hona chahiye. 'Of *your* coming home' sahi hoga.

questions.q: One of the most / widely spread / bad habit / is the use of tobacco.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! 'One of the' ke baad Noun hamesha Plural hota hai. 'Bad habits' sahi hoga.

questions.q: Recently I visited / Kashmir and found / the sceneries / to be breathtaking.
questions.s: Noun Error! 'Scenery' uncountable noun hai. 'The scenery' sahi hoga. 'Sceneries' koi word nahi hota.

questions.q: The brethrens / of this locality / are always / at daggers drawn.
questions.s: Plural Error! 'Brother' ka plural community sense mein 'Brethren' hota hai. Usme 's' lagana galat hai.

questions.q: The wall of this / magnificent building is / fifty foot high / No Error.
questions.s: Measurement Rule! Jab number plural (fifty) ho aur unit adjective (hyphenated) na ho, toh unit bhi plural hoti hai. 'Fifty feet high' sahi hai.

questions.q: If you have a way with words, / a good sense of design and / administration ability, you / may enjoy working in high pressure world of advertising.
o: If you have a way with words,
a good sense of design and
questions.s: Parallelism Error! 'Design' noun hai, toh uske saath parallel structure mein 'Administrative ability' (Adjective + Noun) aana chahiye, na ki 'Administration ability' (Noun + Noun).

questions.q: The Headquarters / of the Army / is in Delhi / No Error.
questions.s: No Error. 'Headquarters' hamesha 's' ke saath likha jata hai aur yahan singular verb 'is' sahi hai kyunki ek specific HQ ki baat ho rahi hai.

questions.q: The issues are / very complex and / the problem is that / they are bound to be obscured by these hypocritical politician.
o: they are bound to be obscured by these hypocritical politician
questions.s: Demonstrative Error! 'These' plural hai, toh iske baad aane wala noun bhi plural hona chahiye. 'Politicians' sahi hoga.

questions.q: We are going to launch / this three-crores project / within the next / few months.
questions.s: Hyphenated Noun! Jab Noun adjective ki tarah kaam kare (hyphen ke baad), toh wo singular rehta hai. 'Three-crore project' sahi hai.

questions.q: I hope to go / to shopping / this weekend / if the weather permits.
questions.s: Phrase Error! 'Go shopping' sahi phrase hai. 'Go to shopping' galat hai kyunki 'Shopping' yahan activity (gerund) hai, destination nahi.

questions.q: The lawyer asked / the complainant / to put his sign / on the paper.
questions.s: Slang vs Formal! 'Sign' verb hai. Noun form 'Signature' hoti hai. 'Put his signature' sahi hai.

questions.q: The cattle / in the meadow / was terrified / to hear the roar of a lion.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! 'Cattle' plural noun hai. Verb 'Were' aayegi.

questions.q: There are / two scores of books / which are lying / unused in the library.
questions.s: Numeral Adjective! 'Score' se pehle number (Two) hai, toh 'Score' singular rahega. 'Two score books' sahi phrase hai ('of' ki zarurat nahi agar direct counting hai).

questions.q: Children / are prone / to making / mischiefs.
questions.s: Noun Error! 'Mischief' uncountable hai. Iska plural nahi banta. 'Mischief' hi rahega.

questions.q: Sheeps are / economically useful / and so they are reared / for wool and meat.
questions.s: Noun Error! 'Sheep' ka singular aur plural same rehta hai. 'Sheeps' galat word hai. 'Sheep are...' sahi hai.

questions.q: I have not gone / through the letter / so I am not aware / of its content.
questions.s: Vocab Trap! Letter ke andar jo likha hota hai wo 'Contents' (plural) hota hai. 'Content' ka matlab 'santushti' hota hai.

questions.q: He knows / many languages / but the German / and the Chinese alphabets will be a problem for him.
o: and the Chinese alphabets will be a problem for him
questions.s: Logic! Varnmala ke liye 'Alphabet' (singular) use hota hai. 'Alphabets' ka matlab 'languages' ho jata hai.

questions.q: The first inning / of the match / was very sensational / No Error.
questions.s: Sports Term! 'Innings' hamesha 's' ke saath aata hai, chahe 1st ho ya 2nd. 'First innings' sahi hai.

questions.q: It is harmful / to take / cupsful of tea / five times a day.
questions.s: Plural Error! '-ful' wale words ka plural last mein 's' lagakar banta hai. 'Cupfuls' sahi word hai, 'Cupsful' nahi.

questions.q: Identify the error: The committee / comprise / five members who / are expert in their field.
questions.s: Subject-Verb Agreement! 'Committee' singular collective noun hai yahan, toh verb 'Comprises' honi chahiye.

questions.q: My sister / has read / pages after pages / of the Bible.
questions.s: Prepositional Noun! Jab Noun + Preposition + Same Noun ho, toh Noun singular rehta hai. 'Page after page' sahi hoga.

questions.q: The beautiful / advices given by / my mother are / valuable.
questions.s: Noun Error! 'Advice' uncountable hai, 's' nahi lagega. 'The beautiful advice' sahi hai.

questions.q: He is / a man / of his words / No Error.
questions.s: Idiom Error! 'Man of his word' (singular) sahi idiom hai. 'Words' ka matlab 'shabd' hota hai, 'Word' ka matlab 'waada' (promise) hota hai.
